title: The Substitution Scheme
next_chapter_hook: That Turtle Shell mark seemed to pierce through time, silently telling an age-old secret at the end of the secret letter—just what was Chen Tianming scheming?

text.content:
Night was as ink-black, moonlight devoured entirely by heavy clouds. In an abandoned courtyard in the western suburbs of the Imperial Capital, candlelight flickered, casting three silhouettes onto the mottled walls.

Ye Qing gently clapped, and a dozen black-clad figures silently emerged from the shadows, like ghosts crawling out of hell. They stood in a row, each wearing exquisitely crafted human skin masks, their faces identical to several important ministers of the Imperial Capital.

"This substitution network required three years of my painstaking cultivation," Ye Qing's voice carried a hint of pride. "If I wished, I could transform half the court into my puppets."

Chen Ji's gaze swept across the line of substitutes, ultimately settling on a young man whose build closely resembled his own. The person appeared around twenty years old, with features surprisingly bearing three points of resemblance. Were it not for the starkly different aura, one might truly mistake him for the real Chen Ji.

dialogue.content:
"His name is Li Dai. I extracted him from death row three months ago." Ye Qing walked to the young man, tilting his chin up with her fingertip. "His mission is to bear those tedious court affairs on behalf of His Highness."

Li Dai respectfully bowed to Chen Ji: "Subordinate Li Dai, willing to serve Your Highness with utmost loyalty."

Chen Ji did not immediately respond, instead circling Li Dai once, his gaze like examining a precise instrument. His fingers lightly tapped his chin, a playful curve forming at the corner of his lips.

text.content:
"And his voice?" Chen Ji suddenly asked.

Ye Qing had long prepared, producing a jade-colored small bottle from her sleeve: "This is a Voice-Changing Elixir. After consuming it, one can mimic anyone's voice within a day. Li Dai has already been lurking by your side for half a month, memorizing your daily tonal habits perfectly."

Chen Ji nodded slightly, his mind rapidly calculating. If this move succeeded, he could break free from the burdensome duties of Crown Prince Grand Tutor and fully investigate the truth behind Han Lie's sudden attack.

But he was equally aware that while the substitution strategy was clever, it resembled dancing on the tip of a blade—once exposed, it would mean utter ruin.

choice.prompt: Chen Ji examined this substitution plan and had to make a critical decision

choices.text: Grant Full Authorization to the Substitute
choices.description: Grant Li Dai the highest authority, allowing him to make decisions at critical moments, while fully retreating into the shadows
choices.visible_cost: If exposed, the Crown Prince Grand Tutor identity will be lost
choices.visible_reward: Gain complete freedom of action, able to fully investigate the truth
choices.risk_hint: The highest risk, but also the richest rewards

text.content:
"Very well." Chen Ji drew a token from his sleeve and tossed it to Li Dai. "This token can mobilize three hundred personal guards of the Crown Prince's mansion. From today onward, you are my shadow."

Li Dai received the token, a flash of excitement in his eyes: "Subordinate will never disappoint Your Highness's great trust!"

Ye Qing在一旁轻笑在一旁轻笑：「殿下果然爽快。不过我很好奇——你如此信任一个刚招揽的死囚，就不怕他在关键时刻背叛？」「In good faith, Ye Qing replied: "Your Highness is indeed decisive. Though I am curious—do you truly trust a death row prisoner you just recruited? Are you not afraid he might betray you at a critical moment?」

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji smiled faintly, his gaze cold as glacial ice: "Betrayal? I have implanted a trace of Tianji Record's energy within him. If I wish, within a hundred li, every thought of his will be crystal clear to me."

Ye Qing paused momentarily, then smiled even more deeply: "So that's it. It seems I underestimated Your Highness."

"The Demonic Path Holy Sect's Soul-Capturing Secret Technique combined with the Tianji Record's energy tracking is indeed double insurance." Ye Qing nodded. "Then I shall hold this一片天 for you in the Imperial Capital. Your Highness may investigate whatever you wish."

text.content:
Chen Ji said nothing more, turning and walking into the night. His figure was soon devoured by darkness, leaving only a soft words drifting in the wind:

"At the court assembly three days later, I will appear once, for the final handover. Everything after that will be left to Li Dai."

Li Dai gazed at that vanishing silhouette, a strange emotion welling in his heart. This legendary supposedly incompetent Crown Prince Grand Tutor was far more terrifying than imagined.

choices.description: Only let Li Dai handle daily trivialities, major decisions involving policy still handled personally
choices.visible_cost: Actions remain constrained, unable to fully investigate
choices.visible_reward: Maintain control over key affairs, reducing the risk of substitution exposure
choices.risk_hint: Relatively stable, but investigation progress will be affected

text.content:
"Substitutes are useful, but cannot be completely relied upon." Chen Ji mused for a moment. "Li Dai only needs to handle court document work and routine official duties. All matters requiring decisions will still be handled by me personally."

Ye Qing slightly frowned: "In that case, Your Highness's movements would still be constrained..."

Chen Ji waved his hand: "It doesn't matter. What I need is not complete disengagement, but to buy enough time. As long as Li Dai can hold out for the first ten days, subsequent matters will be easier."

dialogue.content:
"Ten days?" Ye Qing looked at him thoughtfully. "What exactly does Your Highness intend to investigate? Requiring so much time?"

Chen Ji did not answer directly, merely saying calmly: "The true reason for Han Lie's sudden attack on the Imperial Capital is not simply the conflict between the Three Great Sects and the Tianqing Sect. I have a premonition that the things behind this are far greater than we imagined."

A flash of curiosity crossed Ye Qing's eyes, but seeing Chen Ji had no intention of elaborating, she did not press further. She softly said: "Since Your Highness has already decided, I shall cooperate to the end. However, let me be clear—if Li Dai causes problems, I will not be responsible for cleanup."

"Rest assured, Li Dai will not cause problems." Chen Ji's voice came from the darkness, carrying an undeniable confidence. "Because I will always be watching him."

As his words fell, his silhouette had completely vanished into the night.

Ye Qing gazed at that empty darkness, suddenly laughing softly: "Interesting... this Crown Prince Grand Tutor is far more capable than the rumors suggested."

text.content:
Three days later, at the Imperial Capital court assembly.

Beside the dragon throne that drew all ministers' attention, Chen Ji, in the official robes of Crown Prince Grand Tutor, stood calmly at his position. His substitute Li Dai had left through the side door half an hour earlier, and the two had perfectly completed their handover.

"Your Excellency the Crown Prince Grand Tutor, His Majesty was full of praise for the border defense treatise you submitted last time. Might you have new insights today?" An official approached with a hollow smile.

Chen Ji smiled faintly, clasped his hands: "Too kind. Border defense matters may be discussed later. Today's court assembly should first address the follow-up handling of Han Lie's sudden attack on the Imperial Capital."

choices.description: Besides trusting Li Dai, arrange additional spies to monitor the impostor's every move
choices.visible_cost: Need to divide attention to manage the surveillance system
choices.visible_reward: Minimize the risk of the impostor's betrayal to the greatest extent possible
choices.risk_hint: Consumes more resources, but is much more secure

text.content:
"Trust is trust, but one must always guard against others." Chen Ji pondered for a moment. "Ye Qing, could you lend me some of your hidden agents?"

Ye Qing raised an eyebrow: "Does Your Highness not trust me?"

"On the contrary." Chen Ji shook his head. "Precisely because I trust you, I dare to borrow your blade. If the impostor knows someone is watching, he'll be even more careful, not daring the slightest negligence."

dialogue.content:
Ye Qing stared at him for a moment, then suddenly laughed: "Interesting. Your Highness is truly a remarkable person. Fine, I'll lend you ten hidden agents, enough to monitor Li Dai's every move."

Chen Ji nodded, taking a thin piece of paper from his怀中. It was densely filled with various clauses and rules: "This is Li Dai's code of conduct. Report once daily at the Mao hour. If anything unusual occurs, notify me immediately."

Ye Qing took the paper, glanced at it, and couldn't help but click his tongue: "Even the restroom breaks are scheduled? Your Highness is too..."

"Details determine success or failure." Chen Ji said calmly. "If he harbors even a trace of treachery, I'll know it immediately."

That night, after all arrangements were settled, Chen Ji finally managed to slip away.

He changed into an ordinary gray robe, leaving the official attire and令牌 in the Crown Prince's residence. The entire person seemed to have vanished from the court.

Li Dai appeared normally at court the next day, handling various official duties in the capacity of Crown Prince's Grand Tutor. His performance was flawless—his tone, demeanor, and manner of dealing with ministers were all indistinguishable from Chen Ji's.

The ministers noticed nothing at all. In their eyes, that somewhat wooden Crown Prince's Grand Tutor had long been replaced by another person.

text.content:
The real Chen Ji, meanwhile, was making his way through the dark alleys of the imperial capital. His target was clear—the Xuanwu Sect's secret stronghold in the capital.

Han Lie's sudden raid on the capital was by no means as simple as it appeared. Chen Ji had long sensed something was amiss: why would a sect's number one genius abandon his cultivation to lead an attack on the imperial capital?

Unless... he was searching for something here.

With this question in mind, Chen Ji quietly infiltrated the Xuanwu Sect's establishment in the capital—a pill shop called "Xuanwu Pavilion."

On the surface, Xuanwu Pavilion operated a pill business, but it harbored secrets. Chen Ji entered under the pretense of purchasing pills, and quickly discovered something was wrong—the shop's manager was no ordinary merchant, but a cultivator of considerable strength.

More importantly, aided by the Tianji Record, Chen Ji faintly sensed a familiar aura—a fluctuation unique to temporal-spatial rifts.

"As expected, there's something suspicious." Chen Ji's heart tightened, but on the surface, he calmly purchased a few ordinary pills while secretly observing every detail within the shop.

In a secret chamber behind the shop's courtyard, Chen Ji discovered a hidden passage leading underground. He held his breath, silently infiltrating along the passage.

The underground space was far larger than imagined. Torchlight illuminated rows of bookshelves, but what stood upon them were not books—rather, various ancient scrolls and maps. Chen Ji swept his gaze rapidly, his eyes finally stopping on a map marked with the imperial capital.

On the map, four points at the capital's east, south, west, and north had been circled in red ink. These four points corresponded precisely to the four ancient temples surrounding the capital.

"Four Temples Locking Heaven..." Chen Ji murmured to himself, a terrifying thought suddenly flashing through his mind.

choice.prompt: Chen Ji discovered the Xuanwu Sect's secret layout in the capital and must decide his next move

choices.description: Risk entering the core of the secret chamber to find more evidence and clues
choices.visible_cost: May be discovered and fall into danger
choices.visible_reward: Obtain more complete intelligence to understand the enemy's entire plan
choices.risk_hint: The risk is high, but may uncover the key truth

text.content:
Chen Ji did not hesitate. He continued deeper along the hidden passage.

As he advanced, the temporal-spatial fluctuations in the air grew increasingly intense. Some ancient and dangerous aura permeated his surroundings, causing him to heighten his vigilance involuntarily.

Finally, he arrived at a massive underground chamber. In the center stood a complex formation—eighty-one black stone pillars formed a circle, each pillar carved densely with countless runes.

And at the formation's center, an object emanating a ghostly blue glow floated quietly—a key, forged entirely from some unknown metal, with wisps of spatial rifts coiling around it.

"The Key of Time and Space..." Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply.

He finally understood Han Lie's purpose—this key could open the four temples surrounding the capital, and beneath those temples was sealed an existence capable of destroying the entire continent.

"What enormous ambition." Chen Ji coldly laughed. "Open the four temples, release the seal... The Xuanwu Sect truly wishes to overturn heaven?"

Just then, footsteps echoed from the depths of the passage.

Chen Ji instantly merged into the shadows, holding his breath. Three people approached, and the leader was Han Lie himself. Clad in black battle armor, he radiated a sharp, fierce aura, like a beast about to burst from its cage.

"The key's aura grows stronger." Han Lie stood before the formation, his voice low. "In three more days, it will be the Four Stars Aligned. By then, this key will fully awaken, opening the seals of the four temples."

The two subordinates behind him spoke in unison: "Congratulations, Young Sect Master. Your grand endeavor nears completion!"

Chen Ji observed all this, yet his heart was ice cold. Three days... he only had three days.

choices.description: Preserve strength, return to organize the intelligence already obtained, and devise a complete plan before acting
choices.visible_cost: May miss the opportunity to gain more intelligence
choices.visible_reward: Preserve personal safety, allowing more time to analyze the situation
choices.risk_hint: Relatively secure, but the enemy may accelerate their progress

text.content:
Chen Ji did not act rashly. He knew deeply that confronting a powerful enemy like Han Lie head-on would be like an egg striking a rock.

Quietly retreating from the secret chamber, he retraced his steps to the surface, leaving a hidden tracking talisman at the passage's exit. This talisman could sense fluctuations in the secret chamber's energy and transmit them directly to his Mental Sea.

"Four Stars Aligned, three days from now..." Chen Ji murmured to himself. "Time is running out."

After leaving Xuanwu Pavilion, Chen Ji temporarily rested in a secluded corner of the Imperial Capital. He took out a blank sheet of paper from his breast pocket and recorded everything he had witnessed that day.

Four Temples Locking the Heavens. Key of Time and Space. Four Stars Aligned. Three-Day Deadline.

Each keyword was like a puzzle piece, gradually assembling a shocking complete picture.

"Han Lie wants to release the existence sealed within..." Chen Ji's brow furrowed tightly. "But why would he do that? Once that thing descends, not just the Imperial Capital, the entire continent will turn to ash."

Just as he was lost in thought, a gentle breeze swept by, carrying a familiar scent.

Chen Ji's eyes turned sharp, and the paper and brush in his hands were instantly hidden. When he raised his head, a black-cloaked figure had already stood before him.

The newcomer wore night attire, one of Ye Qing's shadow operatives.

"Your Highness." The shadow operative knelt on one knee. "Your subordinate has urgent matters to report—Li Dai has encountered trouble in the imperial court, with officials growing suspicious of his identity."

Chen Ji's brow furrowed: "What's the situation?"

"Minister of Revenue Liu questioned Li Dai about the memorial submitted yesterday, but Li Dai couldn't answer." The shadow operative spoke rapidly. "Although he temporarily deflected by claiming physical discomfort, Lord Liu seems to have grown suspicious."

Chen Ji冷笑一声："Liu Heng the old fox, quite sharp-nosed indeed."

He pondered for a moment, then quickly reached a decision.

"Tell Li Dai that tomorrow I will personally appear at the Crown Prince's Manor. Have him claim a relapse of old illness and need three days of rest." Chen Ji instructed. "Within these three days, refuse all visitors on grounds of serious illness."

The shadow operative departed with the order.

Chen Ji stood alone in the night, gazing at the faintly twinkling starlight on the horizon, his thoughts churning.

"Three days... I must devise a countermeasure within three days."

choices.description: Tamper with the surroundings of the formation, preventing the key from being awakened during the Four Stars Alignment
choices.visible_cost: May trigger an alarm, alerting Han Lie
choices.visible_reward: Fundamentally destroy the enemy's plan, buying time for subsequent operations
choices.risk_hint: Extremely high risk, but once successful, the effect will be remarkable

text.content:
Chen Ji did not leave; instead, he observed from the shadows for a moment. When Han Lie and the others departed the secret chamber, he quietly slipped inside.

The Key of Time and Space hovered in the center of the formation, emanating a chilling glow. Chen Ji took a deep breath and withdrew three ink-black talismans from his sleeve—these were the "Reverse Void Talismans" he had spent tremendous effort crafting, capable of disrupting the flow of spatial energy.

He silently embedded the three Reverse Void Talismans into three corners of the formation—these positions happened to be the formation's energy nodes. The moment the talismans touched the formation, a faint hum emanated, then fell silent.

"It's done." A subtle smile curved Chen Ji's lips. Just as he was about to leave, he suddenly sensed a fierce killing intent lunging from behind.

"How daring!"

Han Lie's furious roar exploded within the secret chamber, and a tidal wave of oppressive pressure instantly engulfed Chen Ji.

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji's pupils constricted as his body retreated hastily, barely evading the fatal strike. Han Lie's iron fist grazed past Chen Ji's sleeve and crashed into the ground, shattering the solid granite floor into a deep pit several zhang in size.

"It's you!" Han Lie's expression dramatically changed upon recognizing the intruder. "Waste Chen Ji?!"

Chen Ji steadied his stance, his face devoid of any fear; instead, a mocking smile spread across his features: "Young Master Han, been a while."

text.content:
"Waste?" Han Lie was so furious he nearly 七窍生烟. "You actually dared infiltrate Xuanwu Sect's restricted area—you shan't leave alive today!"

He struck again, this time unleashing his full power. His拳风 roared with devastating momentum. Yet Chen Ji had prepared long ago. The instant Han Lie moved, a transport talisman had already appeared in Chen Ji's hand.

"Young Master Han, until we meet again."

The transport talisman transformed into a flash of white light, and Chen Ji's figure vanished from the secret chamber in an instant. Han Lie's fist struck empty air, punching a massive hole through the stone wall behind.

"Chase! Kill him for me!" Han Lie roared.

Chen Ji appeared in the wilderness dozens of li away. He stumbled upon landing, his face turning slightly pale—the transport talisman had consumed a large amount of his spiritual energy, but at least his life was preserved.

"That madman Han Lie..." Chen Ji gasped for breath, barely stabilizing himself. "At least the three Reverse Void Talismans are already in place. During the Four Stars Alignment, the formation is bound to fail."

He sat cross-legged and began recovering his consumed spiritual energy. Meanwhile, his mind rapidly calculated the next strategic moves.

dialogue.content:
"The Reverse Void Talismans can hold for a maximum of five days." Chen Ji murmured to himself. "That means I still have two days to devise a foolproof plan..."

Suddenly, he recalled something—the secret chamber, besides the Key of Time and Space and the formation, also contained a writing desk. It seemed to hold some documents and letters.

He had been in a hurry to retreat back then and hadn't examined them closely.

"Damn it!" Chen Ji cursed inwardly. Those letters might contain more details about Xuanwu Sect's plans.

text.content:
Just then, the night wind carried over a faint, ethereal chime.

Chen Ji猛地抬头, only to see a jet-black paper crane flying from the distance, ultimately landing steadily in his palm. It was Ye Qing's message paper crane.

He unfolded the paper crane, which bore only brief words: "The Crown Prince's Manor secret chamber holds what you seek."

Chen Ji's heart stirred. The Crown Prince's Manor secret chamber? How did he not know the Crown Prince's Manor had a secret chamber?

But without hesitation, he immediately set out to return to the Imperial Capital. Regardless of whether Ye Qing's words were true or false, he had to verify it personally.

The Crown Prince's Manor secret chamber lay beneath an artificial mountain in the rear garden. Following Ye Qing's hints, Chen Ji found the concealed entrance.

The secret chamber was not large, but its furnishings were exquisite. Several ancient paintings hung on the walls, and the bookshelf held various classics. Most eye-catching was a sealed letter on the writing desk.

The envelope bore no name, only a pattern Chen Ji knew too well—a turtle shell.

"This is..." Chen Ji's pupils suddenly constricted, his hands trembling slightly.

This turtle shell pattern was the sole token Chen Tianming had left him before disappearing.

Chen Tianming was Chen Ji's nominal father, yet actually a mysterious and powerful existence. He had taught Chen Ji the initial methods of cultivation, left clues about the Tianji Record, then vanished without a trace.

For ten years, Chen Ji had been searching for Chen Tianming's whereabouts, always to no avail. And now, this turtle shell pattern appeared in the Crown Prince's Manor's secret chamber.

What did this mean? What connection existed between Chen Tianming and the Crown Prince's Manor?

choice.prompt: Chen Ji discovered clues about Chen Tianming and must decide how to handle this mysterious letter

choices.description: Open the letter directly to see what's written inside
choices.visible_cost: If the letter contains a trap, there may be danger
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the information left by Chen Tianming at the first moment
choices.risk_hint: There may be risk, but the value is extremely high

text.content:
Chen Ji took a deep breath and carefully unsealed the envelope.

The paper had yellowed with age, clearly having been placed there for a very long time. Rows of bold, vigorous characters filled the page, each character seeming to contain some special power.

"Ji'er, when you read this letter, I am afraid I am already no longer among the living."

Chen Ji's hands trembled slightly, yet his gaze could not turn away from the letter.

"The Tianji Record did not fall into your hands by chance—it is a forbidden object I brought out from ancient ruins. The Eye of Heavenly Fate has been searching for it, and you... are the chosen vessel."

"The Key of Time and Space in Han Lie's possession originates from the same source as the Tianji Record. The purpose of opening the Four Temples' seal is not to release the sealed existence, but to awaken the sleeping Eye of Heavenly Fate."

"Once the Eye of Heavenly Fate fully awakens, the incomplete Tianji Record within you will be devoured by it, and you... will become its puppet."

Chen Ji's pupils contracted violently, a chill rushing from his feet straight to his brain.

Heaven's Eye! The true origin of the Tianji Record! Behind all of this lay such a terrifying truth!

He continued reading.

"There is one more thing in the secret chamber, your final safeguard. When you must make a choice, it will help you."

"But remember, no matter what happens, do not trust the Heaven's Eye. It appears fair and righteous, yet is utterly cold and merciless. It treats all seers as chess pieces, including your father."

"Finally, protect your sister Chen Nian. She is the Heavenly Fate Key and the key to breaking this cycle."

"— Chen Tianming's Testament"

After reading the letter, Chen Ji remained long unable to calm himself.

Following the letter's instructions, he found an ancient box in the secret chamber's hidden compartment. Inside the box lay a crystal-clear jade pendant, on which was carved a mystic bird with closed eyes.

"Closed-eye mystic bird..." Chen Ji murmured, "What is this?"

The moment he touched the jade pendant, a massive stream of information flooded into his mind. The Tianji Record fragment trembled violently, emitting a blinding golden light.

"Ding—"

A long-unheard voice rang out in the depths of his consciousness.

"Detecting same-source item, Tianji Record attempting fusion..."

"Fusion successful! Gained new ability—'Shield of Heavenly Secrets': Can briefly mask the aura of the Tianji Record, evading the Heaven's Eye's perception. Usable once daily, lasting one hour."

choices.description: Carefully inspect the envelope and paper, see if more clues about Chen Tianming can be found
choices.visible_cost: Will take some time, possibly miss the best timing
choices.visible_reward: More comprehensively understand the situation, avoid possible traps
choices.risk_hint: Relatively safe, but may not be satisfying enough

text.content:
Chen Ji did not rush to open the letter. Instead, he carefully inspected every detail of the envelope and paper.

The envelope was made of superior silkworm paper, a type used only by the imperial family of the Great Chen Dynasty. And the turtle shell mark on the envelope was identical to the pattern on the jade pendant Chen Tianming had left him.

"Indeed, this is father's belongings." Chen Ji felt slightly relieved, but for caution's sake, he still probed the envelope with the Tianji Record's aura, confirming there were no traps before opening the letter.

The letter's content was the same as directly opening it, but at the end of the paper, Chen Ji discovered a detail he had not noticed before—a symbol written with special ink on the back of the paper.

The symbol resembled an eye, but with seven pupils within it.

"Seven-Pupil Heaven's Eye..." Chen Ji's pupils contracted, "This is the mark of the Heaven's Eye!"

His heart plummeted. Could this letter have been tampered with by the Heaven's Eye?

Chen Ji immediately activated the Tianji Record, attempting to analyze the meaning of this symbol. After a moment, a grave expression appeared on his face.

"This is not a trap." He murmured, "This is more like... a mark."

The letter's content was indeed written by Chen Tianming, but adding the Seven-Pupil Heaven's Eye symbol at the end meant this letter had been "observed" by the Heaven's Eye. In other words, the Heaven's Eye knew of this letter's existence and knew Chen Ji would eventually discover it.

"It's waiting for me to take the bait..." Chen Ji冷笑一声, "Unfortunately, you've miscalculated one thing."

He took out the just-obtained closed-eye mystic bird jade pendant and placed the paper on it. The Seven-Pupil Heaven's Eye symbol suddenly trembled violently, then turned into wisps of blue smoke and dissipated.

"Closed-eye mystic bird... can shield the Heaven's Eye's perception." Chen Ji pondered, "Father truly left a backup plan."

After dealing with the letter, Chen Ji discovered several interesting items in the secret chamber.

A yellowed diary recording Chen Tianming's experiences in his youth—he had once been a disciple of the Tianqing Sect, then left the sect for some reason and began traveling the world. The diary also mentioned he had discovered the Tianji Record fragment in ancient ruins and was chosen by it to become the inheritor.

But halfway through the inheritance, he discovered the truth behind the Tianji Record and resolutely abandoned the inheritance, sealing the fragment, waiting for the next suitable vessel.

"So that's how it is..." Chen Ji finally understood the origin of the Tianji Record and the heavy burden on his shoulders.

What he had to face was not only Han Lie and the Xuanwu Sect, but also the Heaven's Eye hiding behind the scenes.

Night deepened, the capital's hustle gradually subsided.

Chen Ji stood on the high platform of the Crown Prince's residence, overlooking this prosperous city. Once he had thought himself merely a loser toyed with by fate, never imagining the true chess game was far grander than he imagined.

The Tianji Record fragment, the Heaven's Eye's conspiracy, Chen Tianming's arrangement, Han Lie's ambition... all converged at this moment.

And he must find the path to victory within this intricate situation.

He lowered his head, gazing at the closed-eye mystic bird jade pendant in his palm. The Tianji Record's aura resonated with the jade pendant, emanating a warm and comforting force.

"Father... what did you go through?" Chen Ji whispered softly.

He knew that to unravel all these mysteries, he must grow stronger, must find the truth behind Chen Tianming's disappearance, must find his sister Chen Nian.

And now, the first step he needed to take was to resolve Han Lie's threat.

"The Void Traversal Talisman is already set. During the four-star alignment in three days, the formation will surely fail." A cold light flashed in Chen Ji's eyes, "Han Lie, you think victory is assured, but you don't know, the mantis stalks the cicada, unaware of the oriole behind."

Just then, another paper crane flew over, landing on Chen Ji's shoulder.

He unfolded the crane. It bore Ye Qing's handwriting: "Your Highness, Han Lie has discovered someone broke into the secret chamber and is conducting a citywide manhunt for the suspected assassin. The city gates have heightened security. Our informants discovered the Xuanwu Sect's people are searching everywhere for a gray-robed man."

A cold smile curved Chen Ji's lips.

"A gray-robed man? Quite observant." He stored the paper crane away and turned to walk into the inner chamber, "Unfortunately, they'll never find me."

Because from this moment on, the identity he would use was no longer the Crown Prince's Grand Teacher, no longer the gray-robed man—but another identity hidden in the shadows.

The Tianji Record's aura was deliberately suppressed. The closed-eye mystic bird jade pendant emanated soft light, enveloping his entire form.

dialogue.content:
"Three days is enough." Chen Ji自言自语, his voice cold and resolute, "Han Lie, you want to open the Four Temples Seal? Then let me show you what true 'Heavenly Secrets' really means."

He closed his eyes. The Tianji Record fragment slowly rotated within his body.

This time, he would no longer passively accept fate, but proactively weave the threads of destiny.

Outside the window, the moon peeked out from the clouds, its cold radiance scattering across the earth. Chen Ji's silhouette was barely visible under the moonlight, like a specter from the abyss.

text.content:
However, just as he prepared to leave the Crown Prince's residence, an unexpected discovery stopped him in his tracks.

In the corner of the back garden, he discovered a withered flower. This was no ordinary bloom, but a rare spiritual plant called "Heavenly Fate Flower."

Heavenly Fate Flowers only grew in places rich with heavenly fate; ordinary people couldn't see them at all. But Chen Ji was different. He possessed the Tianji Record and could see what ordinary people could not.

"The withering of the Heavenly Fate Flower... what does it mean?" Chen Ji crouched down, carefully observing the withered bloom.

Suddenly, he noticed something flickering at the flower's roots.

He gently brushed away the soil and discovered a jade slip buried long ago.

Countless runes were carved on the jade slip, emitting a faint glow. Chen Ji picked it up, and a familiar aura rushed toward him.

"This is... father's aura!"

He quickly injected spiritual energy into the jade slip. After a moment, a blurry image emerged from within.

In the image, a middle-aged man stood amidst ruins. His features bore some resemblance to Chen Ji, but appeared more mature and weathered.

"Ji'er, if you're seeing this image, it means you've found the secret chamber in the Crown Prince's residence." The man spoke, his voice low and gentle, "Time is running out. I must tell you the final truth..."

The image suddenly trembled violently. The middle-aged man's figure began to blur.

"Remember, the Heavenly Fate Key is the key to breaking the cycle... find your sister... she's at..."

The image vanished completely, leaving only Chen Ji alone, clutching the now-dim jade slip, unable to回过神来.

Chen Nian.

His sister, the girl taken away by the Holy Sect.

Chen Ji had always thought that finding Chen Nian was merely his goal of revenge and seeking family, never expecting her to be so intimately connected to all these truths.

"Heavenly Fate Key... the key to breaking the cycle..." Chen Ji repeated these words, a complex emotion rising in his heart.

He raised his head, gazing toward the distant night sky. There, the stars were slowly moving, as if invisible threads of fate were drawing all of them toward an unknown terminus.

The four-star alignment in three days.

Han Lie's conspiracy.

The Heaven's Eye's observation.

Chen Tianming's arrangement.

Chen Nian's whereabouts.

All clues pointed in the same direction—a grand scheme concerning the fate of the entire continent. And he, Chen Ji, would become the most crucial piece in this grand scheme.

No, he was not a piece.

He was the Chess Player.

Under the moonlight, Chen Ji's silhouette gradually merged into the night.

He left the Crown Prince's residence, heading swiftly toward the city outskirts. There lay a secret stronghold he had prepared long ago. There, he would formulate detailed plans to face the crisis in three days.

However, what he did not notice was that not far behind him, a pair of eyes hidden in the darkness were quietly watching the direction of his departure.

The owner of those eyes was entirely shrouded in a black robe, their face concealed in shadow. But had Chen Ji turned back at this moment, he would have been greatly astonished—

Beneath the black robe, the faint outline of robes embroidered with a turtle shell pattern was visible.

"Finally... found you."

The black-robed figure murmured, the voice hoarse and aged, carrying an indescribably complex emotion.

The night wind blew past. The black-robed figure vanished silently into the night as they had come. Only that whispered words lingered in the wind—

"Turtle shell mark... father..."

Chen Ji could never have imagined that the answer he desperately sought was quietly following behind him. And that familiar turtle shell pattern on the secret letter seemed to silently speak of a long-sealed secret—

What exactly was Chen Tianming planning?
